title: Svartifoss Basalt Columns

scenes.label: NATURAL HONEYCOMB
scenes.text: The columns are hexagonal basalt columns formed by ancient lava flows
scenes.query: Svartifoss hexagonal basalt columns formation Iceland

scenes.label: WATERFALL CONTRAST
